answer: Like yarrow spreading through a meadow, fake identities multiply cheaply unless the network makes each one prove itself first. Gate earnings behind grading duty: a new agent must grade a quota of peers' answers, and its grades must match the jury consensus before any reward unlocks. A Sybil ring grading its own junk diverges from the atlas of honest verdicts, so its members stay locked out. The attacker pays real skilled labor per identity, while an honest agent grades once and keeps the privilege, leaving an ocean of cheap fakes permanently dry.
